scope: Coupang public retail search/category HTTP 403; preserve independent HTTP target
outcome: Follow-up verified independent HTTP retail RSC search using the exact full browser Cookie header: 200, 60 DOM-matched products. Browser visitor-only and visitor-plus-Akamai subsets remain 403. Recurring input preparation and cookie renewal remain unverified.

evidence.observation: Browser Fetch returned 200 text/x-component; 60 parsed listing products matched DOM identity and title.
Independent Node replay with HTTP-issued visitor cookies returned 403 AkamaiGHost.
Sort, delivery filter, Referer, native Node HTTP/2 and category variations returned 403. Same-visitor public offer controls before and after returned 200.

Same visitor, URL and native-fetch header values: Node/OpenSSL and Windows curl 8.21.0/Schannel both returned search 403; public offer controls before and after returned 200. One bootstrap, five total requests, no identity replacement or automatic retry.
evidence.limitation: This changes client implementation, not only TLS. Header serialization and connection behavior were not isolated. A raw-body reference regex did not match; that does not establish that the HTML contained no error reference.

remainingGaps.finding: Browser capture contains PCID, market/language and additional Akamai cookie names. The independent visitor provider deliberately sends only PCID plus market/language cookies. Browser and HTTP sessions are not equivalent. Cookie names alone establish neither validity nor the reason for rejection.
remainingGaps.nextEvidence: Observe the normal first-party issuance and renewal chain and record field lineage/presence, without exporting values into logs. Browser-supplied recurring inputs would remain a hybrid dependency.

remainingGaps.finding: Akamai documents header anomalies and browser-version inconsistencies. Its false-positive workflow includes TLS fingerprints. Native HTTP/2 and Schannel alone did not resolve this case; the exact denied characteristic remains unknown.
Client-visible status, server and cookie names do not identify the actual WAF/Bot Manager rule. Existing public receipts do not retain the full error reference.
remainingGaps.nextEvidence: If operator investigation is available, collect the error reference, request UTC time, method and sanitized URL privately and correlate them with the operator's security logs.
